answer: Because the trellis index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the nebula audit republishes the digest set at close. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a lotus index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Filling 82 aliases thus needs 82 distinct prompts, so the operator burns the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
